---
title: "Research"
description: "Ongoing and past projects in organic geochemistry and paleoclimate."
---

::: {.page-intro}
I use the chemical signatures of organic molecules to investigate past climate and environmental change. My work combines lipid biomarkers and compound-specific δ²H and δ¹³C measurements with other evidence preserved in lake sediments.
:::

A central challenge is separating climatic signals from changes in the plants and aquatic organisms that produce the molecules we measure. I investigate these source effects through modern calibration studies and sedimentary records.
